author: TaniaMS
title: 1 Star - very poor customer service
content:
⭐️ 1 Star

I was a loyal, paying Lightning Link Casino player for over three years. Recently, I contacted technical support because I was experiencing what I believed was unusual gameplay, including receiving very few bonuses or bonuses that were extremely small compared with my gameplay.

Instead of addressing my concerns or asking me any questions to clarify what I meant, customer support took a sentence from my message, interpreted it in a way I did not intend, and blocked my account. I still had money in the game when I was blocked, and my request for a refund was refused.

I have contacted them three separate times requesting to speak with a supervisor and requesting a refund, and I have not received a meaningful response to either request.

After more than three years as a paying customer, I am extremely disappointed by the way this complaint was handled. I believe customers should be able to raise concerns about gameplay and receive an explanation rather than being blocked without having their concerns addressed.

The way my complaint was handled has completely destroyed my trust in this app. I will not be returning to Lightning Link Casino, and I would strongly encourage anyone considering spending money in the app to think carefully about how customer complaints are handled.

author: Jerry Honda
title: Trash game
content:
Terrible Experience — Customer Service Takes No Responsibility

Absolutely horrible experience. I had a connectivity issue while playing, and their own investigation confirmed that there was an interruption happening before and during the bet. They even acknowledged that an error appeared and that the round was unable to finish processing.

So what was their solution? Basically: “Yes, there was a problem, but we’re not giving you anything back.”

How does that make sense? If your own server records confirm there was a connectivity problem and the game failed to process properly, the customer shouldn’t be the one left taking the loss.

I’ve spent a significant amount of money on this platform, and this is how they choose to treat a customer when there is an issue on their end. The worst part is that they hide behind technical language instead of actually taking responsibility and making things right.

Very disappointing customer service. If you’re willing to spend your hard-earned money here, just know that when something goes wrong, you may be left dealing with the consequences even when their own records acknowledge that an issue occurred.

I would strongly recommend thinking twice before spending your money with this company. There are plenty of platforms that understand the importance of taking care of their customers. Unfortunately, this company clearly isn’t one of them.

Play a different game guys unless you’ve got all the money in the world to buy coins with real money

author: DEVLLDRLVEN
title: GREAT GAMES TERRIBLE EXECUTION
content: While Lighting Link Casino does have a majority of your favorite slots from the casino. The app is extremely buggy and has a poor UI that is not very intuitive. You would think the secondary missions of collecting points to complete card sets of your favorite characters like Mo mummy and General Tso would be fun but it’s mostly repetitive gems that can’t really help you. The constellation system is unique and a much better feature than the cards but is less lucrative than the card collection which isn’t saying much. The “free coins” feature if you are out of coins is also very predatory with it having you click out of 3 screens to buy coins with real money to get the little bit of coins to play for free. This feature also does not work sometimes saying “collect your uncollected rewards” but there are none. Customer support is non existent and all “help” is AI chat bots.
